title: Weight of subsets containing a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\delta$ be real, and let $i$ be a coordinate in $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$. The sum over subsets $J$ containing $i$ of $\\delta^{|J|}(1-\\delta)^{n-|J|}$ is $\\delta$.
